body.title: Implement resolveSecurityModel (bounded async availability probe)
body.summary: function resolveSecurityModel(cfg, registry, opts: {deadlineMs, signal?}): Promise<SecurityModelSelection>. Calls resolveSecurityModelCandidate first; if already 'unavailable', returns immediately with no probe. Otherwise awaits exactly one bounded probe (a minimal CliProvider call) against the candidate, racing it against opts.deadlineMs and opts.signal; maps rejection/non-zero/ENOENT, timeout, and cancellation to distinct blockerReasons. Never rejects; always settles within opts.deadlineMs.
acceptanceChecks: Candidate already 'unavailable' -> resolves immediately, no probe attempted
Probe resolves successfully within the deadline -> status:'configured'
Probe rejects (simulated ENOENT/auth failure) -> status:'unavailable' with a backend-failure blockerReason
Probe neither resolves nor rejects before opts.deadlineMs -> status:'unavailable' with a timeout blockerReason
opts.signal aborted while the probe is outstanding -> status:'unavailable' with a cancellation blockerReason

Live (INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1): a valid, listed, floor-eligible pin whose backend is deliberately unreachable resolves 'unavailable' with a populated blockerReason within the deadline, never a hang or silent substitution
